title: Azure Partner Channel Check Q1 FY2026
text:
contact_type: reseller geography: North America product: Azure AI observation: Demand for Azure OpenAI Service strong; deal cycles accelerating in financial services sentiment: positive data_point: +40 unit: % YoY deal count
contact_type: VAR geography: Europe product: Azure observation: Enterprise migrations from on-premises accelerating; hybrid cloud seeing renewed interest post-regulatory clarity sentiment: positive data_point: +22 unit: % YoY pipeline
contact_type: distributor geography: North America product: Microsoft 365 Copilot observation: Copilot attach rates on E5 renewals running at 35%; customers cautious on broader rollout until ROI is clearer sentiment: mixed data_point: 35 unit: % attach rate on E5
contact_type: reseller geography: Asia Pacific product: Azure observation: APAC growth strong led by Japan and Australia; India datacenter investment driving local demand sentiment: positive data_point: +45 unit: % YoY deal count
contact_type: OEM geography: North America product: Windows Server observation: Windows Server 2025 refresh cycle beginning; channel partners expect 18-month upcycle sentiment: positive data_point: +15 unit: % YoY units
contact_type: VAR geography: Europe product: Azure AI observation: EU AI Act compliance concerns creating demand for Microsoft compliance tooling on Azure sentiment: positive data_point: +28 unit: % YoY pipeline
contact_type: distributor geography: North America product: GitHub Copilot observation: Developer adoption of Copilot strong in enterprises; churn rate low at approximately 3% sentiment: positive data_point: 3 unit: % monthly churn
contact_type: reseller geography: North America product: Dynamics 365 observation: Dynamics 365 + Copilot deals accelerating; displacing Salesforce in mid-market sentiment: positive data_point: +18 unit: % YoY deal count
